scope: static TTS license and packaged-asset layering only
selectionRule: No final engine, model, speaker or voice may be inferred from examples, release order, availability or this matrix.

rows.claim: The Sherpa-ONNX v2.0.1 code revision and both published Android AAR identities are fixed.
proof: git ls-remote resolved the annotated tag to the recorded commit
GitHub expanded-assets metadata supplied both SHA-256 digests
HTTP HEAD independently confirmed both exact byte lengths
limitations: No relevant AAR/JAR was present in the allowed local Gradle cache
AAR entry-level notices and embedded native versions were not re-inspected

rows.claim: The Sherpa-ONNX Android build pins ONNX Runtime 1.28.2 and the archive hashes for the shared Android zip and static ABI builds are recorded.
rows.packageAction: Include the exact MIT license and ONNX Runtime ThirdPartyNotices.txt for the selected shared or static variant; do not infer the selected variant from the AAR name.

rows.claim: No final Sherpa voice/model has been selected, so its license, model card, training-data restrictions, file hashes and speaker identity cannot be approved.
requiredInputs: exact model release or archive URL
archive and extracted file SHA-256
LICENSE/MODEL_CARD and copyright holder
training-data or usage restrictions
speaker/voice identifier when the model is multi-speaker
final packaged file paths

rows.claim: The selected model determines whether tokens.txt, lexicon.txt, a jieba dictionary, rule FST/FAR files or other phonemization data are required; no final file set or per-file provenance is fixed.
requiredInputs: selected model config and generated file manifest
every shipped tokens/lexicon/dictionary/rule file hash
license and copyright source for each independently authored data file
confirmation that no runtime phonemizer download is enabled

rows.claim: For Sherpa-ONNX v2.0.1 VITS and Matcha configs, data_dir is documented as deprecated and ignored because espeak-ng is no longer used; other model families remain unselected.

facts.vitsDataDirComment: Deprecated. Ignored since v2.0.0: espeak-ng is no longer used.
facts.matchaDataDirComment: Deprecated. Ignored since v2.0.0: espeak-ng is no longer used.
facts.boundary: Do not carry the old Sherpa eSpeak payload into a VITS or Matcha package without a selected model proving that it is used.

rows.remainingQuestion: If a non-VITS/non-Matcha model is later selected, enumerate and license any external eSpeak-ng engine or data it actually packages.

rows.claim: Piper1-GPL v1.8.0 code is fixed at the official tag and declares GPL-3.0-or-later.
rows.packageAction: Use the full GPL-3.0-or-later text and corresponding source/build scripts; do not rely on a wheel or the word Piper alone as provenance.

rows.claim: Piper has no selected voice; the required .onnx and .onnx.json files plus their MODEL_CARD licensing terms are absent.

facts.voiceDocsStatement: Each MODEL_CARD contains important licensing information and some voices may have restrictive licenses.

requiredInputs: exact voice .onnx and .onnx.json URLs and SHA-256 values
MODEL_CARD and its hash
speaker identification for multi-speaker models
training-data and usage restrictions
final packaged file paths

rows.claim: Piper builds and packages eSpeak NG code/data, but the repository exposes two official build-path pins and no Android build path has been selected.
rows.remainingQuestion: Choose the actual libpiper or Python-extension build path, then freeze one eSpeak NG commit, data tree hash, library hash and all notice files.

rows.claim: Piper Chinese phonemization references a downloadable g2pW archive; the exact archive, extracted model/data hashes and complete redistribution terms are not fixed.

facts.runtimeBehavior: download_model() calls urlopen when g2pw.onnx is absent

requiredInputs: archive SHA-256 and resolved immutable URL or commit
extracted g2pw.onnx and dictionary/data hashes
all bundled license and notice files
offline packaging that removes the runtime download fallback
zero-network runtime evidence in the later explicit runtime gate

rows.claim: Piper has no official Android artifact; direct libpiper defaults to ONNX Runtime 1.22.0 for desktop-oriented CI paths, and no Android ABI/library bundle is fixed.
requiredInputs: approved Android NDK/JNI build path
four ABI or explicit ABI policy
libpiper, libonnxruntime and dependent library hashes
exact build flags and source bundle
runtime/device gate in a later authorized task

rows.claim: A final TTS notice/source bundle cannot be generated before engine, model, voice, phonemization assets and Android build path are selected.
requiredInputs: final engine/model/voice decision
final packaged TTS file list from APK/AAB rather than Gradle graph
per-file component mapping and SHA-256
license texts, copyright holders and NOTICE/third-party notices
corresponding source or written offer where the selected license requires it
final bundle SHA-256 and packaged SBOM
